description: Two-finger pinch centered on a point: scale > 1 spreads the fingers (zoom in), scale < 1 brings them together.

scale.description: Final finger distance ÷ initial distance, e.g. 2 or 0.5

window.description: Window: target id from list_windows or part of its title. Optional when only one window is open.

x.description: Center x, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

y.description: Center y, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

name: pinch
title: Pinch
